layer_playback.fseq: v2.2, zstd, 64 channels in 4 sparse ranges of 16 (one per head), 9870 frames of 20 ms
layer_playback.xsq_layers: per head: the first EffectLayer holds the 26-28 section effects, the second the 4 transition effects; no setting names a LayerMethod

frames_inside_transition_effects.unit: channel-frames within ±1 of the sampled value

example.head: MH2
example.channel_11: played 123 until 129620, then 39 (the base layer's cut); the transition layer would have glided 123 -> 100

layer_playback.finding: where a base effect covered the frame, xLights played the base layer; the transition layer showed only where the base had no effect (MH1 and MH4 in a section without them, 129620-150900 ms), as a fade from or to nothing. Between two sections every boundary played as a cut. The 393 'neither' channel-frames are base curves faster than this sampling, none matches the transition layer
